rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a suggestion or the act of putting one forward.

example.english: I have a suggestion for you.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jau5 go3 gin3 ji5 bei2 nei5

rows.note: Use this when the suggestion is specifically a proposal put forward for consideration, rather than general advice.

example.english: I want to put forward a suggestion at the meeting to add another class.
example.traditional: 我想喺會上提議加開一班。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 hai2 wui6 soeng6 tai4 ji5 gaa1 hoi1 jat1 baan1

rows.note: Use this for an implied suggestion or hint that leads someone to infer an idea.

example.english: The way he said it was basically a suggestion that I should resign.
example.traditional: 佢咁樣講，根本就係暗示我應該辭職。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam3 joeng2 gong2 gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 am3 si6 ngo5 jing1 goi1 ci4 zik1
